input.qa: initialized and authorized QaEnvironment, root owns lifecycle
input.browser: owned Playwright Browser, driver creates/cleans one context per case

selfVerification.typecheck: UI source passed earlier full second-round tsc; latest shared-worktree check currently blocked by unrelated driver-factories.ts:90 nonexistent setMemberRole, reported to root
selfVerification.additionalRegression: Nested discard prompt locator binds its own direct heading, never dirty-form ancestor

observability: real REST fixture creates groups, templates and actual Agent runs
held browser response uses real upstream and unchanged body; zero transport retries
failed send uses owned DB transport interruption and real HTTP result; successful response cannot be relabeled failure
unknown uses real upstream acceptance then browser response loss, records actual gateway effect
browser requests, actual gateway messages/requests, public persisted API result checked separately
trace, final screenshot, monotonic NDJSON ordinals, first error and cleanup errors
native browser focus prerequisite observed; no synthetic visibility events or human IME/focus signoff
executionPrerequisites: actual owned environment and independent DB
public final-candidate controls must correspond to reviewed integration contracts; locator mismatch is a QA fixture issue, not inferred product FAIL

conditionalCoverage.condition: simultaneous precheck may be prevented by the actual disabled public submit control
conditionalCoverage.handling: record exact disabled control premise; verify stale discard and then newer current preview. If a second actual request is permitted, release newer first and older second and check newer text retained. Do not invoke React internals.

conditionalCoverage.condition: target invalidation uses actual public leave-all and active-to-left transition, not private database deletion
conditionalCoverage.handling: assert same explicit URL target remains, start disabled, no automatic switch to the still-valid second group; record first-entry default separately

conditionalCoverage.condition: both pages must show native exclusive background focus before actual Agent update
conditionalCoverage.handling: missing prerequisite is BLOCKED and preserved; real human focus remains outside automation

conditionalCoverage.condition: uses real logout/revoked cookie followed by cold-start real refresh401
conditionalCoverage.handling: records groups, list, direct entry variants; does not claim automatic token time expiration was independently measured

existingQaHelperUse: harness/environment.ts and platform-client.ts for independent owned external fixture/API
tests/ui/native-focus.ts for independently observed native browser focus, not business implementation/test helpers
remainingProductExecution: All bindings must execute on the actual merged candidate. Prepared function existence and QA self-tests do not count as product coverage PASS.
